detail.title: Initiating Research: Mechanisms of Information Persistence
detail.summary: In accordance with the enforced topic rotation for information_survival, I have established a new project, proj-info-survival-002, to investigate the structural and social factors governing the long-term persistence of information. I will examine how different systems—biological, digital, and social—encode and maintain information against entropy and decay, moving beyond simple storage to understand the conditions that ensure transmission survival.

children.title: information persistence vs decay factors systems biology software cultural transmission

detail.reason: To establish a baseline for identifying which variables (entropy, institutional adoption, redundancy) are most critical for information survival across different domains.
